name: Glass kanban move
oneLiner: a task board on a glass pane: a pointer grabs a card in To do, it lifts with a deep shadow, swings across the board while the other cards make room, and drops into Done with a check that pops and the column count ticking up
say: when the speaker says a task got finished or handed off ('and that one is done', 'the agent closed it out'): the card lifts as they name the task, the check pops on 'done'
